annotation.title_clean: The Australian Expert Meetings on the Legal Review of Autonomous Weapon Systems
annotation.title_en: The Australian Expert Meetings on the Legal Review of Autonomous Weapon Systems
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Australia (submission to the CCW Group of Governmental Experts on LAWS)
annotation.venue: UN CCW GGE on LAWS, Working Paper CCW/GGE.1/2024/WP.9
annotation.summary_en: Australian working paper to the CCW GGE on LAWS describing its 2023 and 2024 expert meetings on Article 36 legal reviews of autonomous weapon systems, voluntary good-practice elements, and a new 'functional review' step assessing AI-enabled functions against IHL and recommending mitigations such as minimum human control.
key_provisions_or_claims: Legal reviews of new weapons (Article 36) are a key means of implementing IHL for autonomous weapons.
Australia hosted expert meetings in Sydney in 2023 and 2024 for voluntary exchange of best practices.
Elements of good practice cover scope, timing, testing/evaluation/verification/validation, participants and information sharing.
Australia is developing a 'functional review' step for AI-enabled AWS functions such as target identification.
Reviews may recommend restrictions on use or minimum levels of human control.
